name: Machine Log
shortDescription: Record machine counters, read photos and document production history.
fullDescription:
Machine Log helps you document your machines’ production counters. Record piece counts, cycles, operating hours or quantities and keep track of your readings.

Counters that fit your machines
Choose a preset counter type or enter your own type and unit. Add a machine number, production area and a matching icon.

Readings by hand or photo
Enter a value manually or read numbers from a camera photo or an existing image. Text recognition processes the photo on your device. Check and confirm the recognized value before saving.

Traceable history
The app calculates increases between readings and handles backdated entries, resets and counter replacements. Corrections retain the original details and earlier photos. You can add a reason for each correction.

Reminders and PDF reports
Set up regular reading reminders. Create individual reports or a counter history as a PDF, compact or with photos. Open, print and share saved reports.

Encrypted backups
Create password-protected backups of your data, photos and reports. Choose where to save them and restore your backup when needed.

Six languages
German, English, Spanish, French, Italian and Brazilian Portuguese. Choose an app language in settings or follow your system language. Numbers and dates follow your device’s region.

No account and no ads
Your counter data stays in private app storage. Machine Log has no server of its own and offers no cloud sync. The Store app does not require internet permission. See the privacy policy for details about the included Google ML Kit SDK.
